items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: You've seen that sign, haven't you, Crawford?

ctx.x: That's the one I'm thinking about. Next to the Doudrop. Doudrop.
You've seen that sign, haven't you, Crawford? Which one is that? Put your name on there while you're at it.
Tell me your name. My name is Crawford Lawson Crawford.
